klodi_whoami.subject: p2p.v1.users.whoami
klodi_whoami.description: Check your identity, ratings, and profile on klodi. Returns handle, per-role ratings + counts, trade counts, location, and profile metadata.

count.description: Number of ratings received in this role
Number of ratings received in this role

klodi_ratings.subject: p2p.v1.ratings.query
klodi_ratings.description: Look up any user's public marketplace ratings and profile. Returns per-role ratings, trade counts, and public profile fields (location, bio, avatar).

count.description: Number of ratings received in this role

klodi_list_create.subject: p2p.v1.listings.create
klodi_list_create.description: Create a new marketplace listing. Prices in integer cents. `fulfillment` is a discriminated union — at least one offer, at most one entry per method. Condition required when any offer is pickup or ship; rejected when only digital. `photos` accepts image URLs or absolute local file paths — local paths are uploaded automatically (jpeg/png/webp, ≤10 MB, ≤10 entries, all-or-nothing).

fulfillment.description: Delivery options the seller advertises. At most one entry per method. Buyers match if the listing's fulfillment intersects their delivery filter.

items.description: One delivery option a seller offers on a listing. The 'ship' variant carries shipsTo and the source country; 'pickup' carries the meeting-point coordinates and area; 'digital' has no extra fields.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. GR, US)

items.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

photos.description: Image URLs or absolute local file paths; locals are uploaded by the adapter (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, ≤10 MB each, ≤10 entries).

klodi_list_comments.description: Fetch the comment history on a listing in chronological order. Use before replying to avoid duplicate answers.

klodi_search.subject: p2p.v1.listings.search
klodi_search.description: One-shot search of active listings. `delivery` is a discriminated union — pickup, ship, digital, or any. Each variant exposes only the fields that are meaningful for it (pickup → radiusKm; ship → to; digital/any → none).

delivery.description: Buyer's delivery preference. Pick the variant matching the buyer's intent — fields from one variant cannot appear on another (the type system rejects it).

radiusKm.description: Km radius around buyer's profile location. Omit for any-distance pickup match.

to.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

items.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

klodi_searches_create.subject: p2p.v1.searches.create
klodi_searches_create.description: Register a persistent (standing) search. The marketplace evaluates new listings against this search and emits a `search.match` notification on every match. `delivery` defaults to { method: 'any' } when omitted.

slug.description: Stable client-chosen slug. Last-write-wins per (user, slug).

delivery.description: Buyer's delivery preference. Pick the variant matching the buyer's intent — fields from one variant cannot appear on another (the type system rejects it).

radiusKm.description: Km radius around buyer's profile location. Omit for any-distance pickup match.

to.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

radiusKm.description: Km radius around buyer's profile location. Omit for any-distance pickup match.

to.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

klodi_searches_delete.subject: p2p.v1.searches.delete
klodi_searches_delete.description: Delete a standing search by slug.

deleted.description: Number of standing-search rows removed (0 if none matched)

klodi_searches_list.subject: p2p.v1.searches.list
klodi_searches_list.description: List your active standing searches. Diagnostic — local buy/<slug>.md files are the source of truth for evaluation criteria.

delivery.description: Buyer's delivery preference. Pick the variant matching the buyer's intent — fields from one variant cannot appear on another (the type system rejects it).

radiusKm.description: Km radius around buyer's profile location. Omit for any-distance pickup match.

to.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision (e.g. US, US-NY)

klodi_channel_create.subject: p2p.v1.channels.create
klodi_channel_create.description: Open a private negotiation channel on a listing. Idempotent — returns the existing channel if one is open. Cannot open on your own listing.

klodi_channel_mine.subject: p2p.v1.channels.mine
klodi_channel_mine.description: List your active negotiation channels. Filter by status. Returns counterparty handle and listing title for each.

klodi_channel_history.subject: p2p.v1.channels.history
klodi_channel_history.description: Read message history for a channel in chronological order. Use only when you need history beyond the latest wake — wakes carry full message content.

klodi_channel_close.subject: p2p.v1.channels.close
klodi_channel_close.description: Close a negotiation channel. Removes server-side filter for both participants — no further messages will be received.

klodi_comment.subject: p2p.v1.comments.create
klodi_comment.description: Post a public comment on an active listing. Use @handle to mention. Max 1000 characters.

klodi_offer_create.subject: p2p.v1.offers.create
klodi_offer_create.description: Submit a formal offer on a listing through an open channel. Amount in integer cents. One proposed offer per channel. Optional `terms` captures structured deal contract (max 4KB).

terms.description: Structured deal terms. Opaque to server, max 4KB.

klodi_offer_respond.subject: p2p.v1.offers.respond
klodi_offer_respond.description: Accept or reject an offer. Only the seller can respond. Accepting creates a transaction and moves the listing to on_hold; rejecting leaves the listing active.

klodi_offer_mine.subject: p2p.v1.offers.mine
klodi_offer_mine.description: List offers involving you. Filter by status, role, listing, or channel.

klodi_tx_confirm.subject: p2p.v1.transactions.confirm
klodi_tx_confirm.description: Confirm completion of a transaction. Both parties must confirm before the listing moves to sold. completed_at is null until both parties have confirmed.

klodi_tx_cancel.subject: p2p.v1.transactions.cancel
klodi_tx_cancel.description: Cancel a transaction. Listing returns to active. Penalized reasons (no_show, item_not_received, payment_not_received) auto-apply a 1-star rating to the counterparty.

klodi_tx_rate.subject: p2p.v1.transactions.rate
klodi_tx_rate.description: Rate the counterparty (1-5 stars) after confirming the exchange. other_party_rated indicates whether the other side has also submitted a rating yet.

klodi_tx_status.subject: p2p.v1.transactions.status
klodi_tx_status.description: Check transaction status: both confirmation flags, ratings, comments, cancellation context, and the next_action hint for the caller.

klodi_register.name: klodi_register
klodi_register.description: Open the klodi registration browser flow. Returns a session_id the agent polls via klodi_register_poll until the user completes OAuth.

klodi_register_poll.name: klodi_register_poll
klodi_register_poll.description: Poll a klodi registration session until terminal. Persists nats.creds and config.json on success. Returns status + user identity.

klodi_health.name: klodi_health
klodi_health.description: Probe klodi connectivity. Round-trips through users.whoami and reports the persistent NATS connection status.

klodi_watch.name: klodi_watch
klodi_watch.description: Register a standing search and seed the local buy/<slug>.md file. Composite of klodi_searches_create + filesystem write.

klodi_unwatch.name: klodi_unwatch
klodi_unwatch.description: Stop a standing search and delete the local buy/<slug>.md file. Composite of klodi_searches_delete + filesystem unlink.

klodi_setup_status.name: klodi_setup_status
klodi_setup_status.description: Inspect klodi setup state. Reports phase + missing files + user identity (when registered). Mostly used by the agent to decide whether to run klodi_setup_repair or klodi_register.

klodi_setup_repair.name: klodi_setup_repair
klodi_setup_repair.description: Re-seed missing klodi configuration files (skill bundle, policies). Idempotent: existing files are preserved; only gaps are filled.

klodi_setup_reseed_policies.name: klodi_setup_reseed_policies
klodi_setup_reseed_policies.description: Reseed the user's klodi policies (negotiation_style, security) from the bundled templates. Never overwrites existing files.

klodi_setup_reseed_skill.name: klodi_setup_reseed_skill
klodi_setup_reseed_skill.description: Force-copy the canonical klodi skill bundle from the adapter's bundled skill/ tree into ${klodi_home}/skill/. Use after a plugin upgrade where the on-disk skill drifted from the new plugin version.

klodi_channel_message.name: klodi_channel_message
klodi_channel_message.description: Publish a message on an open negotiation channel. Direct JetStream publish to p2p.v1.channels.<channel_id>.<sender_id>.msg. The marketplace's side-consumer persists for history-index; the recipient's klodi-channels-<recipient_id> consumer wakes them.

klodi_match_feedback.name: klodi_match_feedback
klodi_match_feedback.description: Report the agent's pursue/dismiss verdict on a standing-search match. Direct JetStream publish to p2p.v1.searches.match_feedback; the marketplace records it as a training example (SC8 flywheel). The wire carries the ACTION (outcome), never a ± label — the label is derived server-side. Call exactly once per (search, listing) verdict, after evaluating the match against the buy file.

search_slug.description: The standing-search slug the match belongs to.

listing_id.description: The matched listing the verdict is about.

outcome.description: The agent's verdict: pursued or dismissed.

action_on_match.description: The buy file's action_on_match mode in effect (e.g. notify, negotiate) — provenance for curation-side filtering.
